title: Frontend Role Module Create, Audit & Repair Workflow Engine

MODE_A.name: Create (Web)
MODE_A.description: Construct brand-new modules or sub-modules from scratch with strict adherence to 14-folder standard, Zod schemas, React Hook Form, and design tokens.

MODE_B.name: Audit + Repair (Web)
MODE_B.description: Exhaustive zero-sampling audit of existing web modules, generating actionable repair plans and executing non-destructive fixes under the Zero Feature Eviction Law.

MODE_C.name: Cross-Platform Mobile Create
MODE_C.description: Generate React Native/Expo mobile modules adhering to mobile tokens, AccessibilityInfo, and native gesture guidelines.

MODE_D.name: Mobile Audit + Repair
MODE_D.description: Audit and repair React Native mobile apps against mobile design tokens and platform safety requirements.

zeroSamplingProtocol.mandate: Every single file, view, sub-component, button, modal, form input, state branch, and contract must be systematically inspected. Statistical or partial sampling is strictly prohibited.
verificationChecklist: No unresolved TypeScript errors (npx tsc --noEmit must return 0)
No broken imports or missing module exports
No crude window.alert or window.confirm calls
No unhandled pending, error, or empty states
All unit and integration tests passing

evidenceClassification.SOURCE_CONFLICT: Conflicting rules between supplied specification files.
evidenceClassification.CONTRACT_CONFLICT: Product or API contract conflicts with an applicable architectural rule.
evidenceClassification.BLOCKED_BY_SUPPLIED_SCOPE: Required evidence or feature falls outside the user-supplied task boundary.
evidenceClassification.NOT_VERIFIED: Insufficient available evidence to confirm compliance or failure.
evidenceClassification.BLOCKED_BY_SUPPLIED_CONTRACT: Verified contract makes safe execution impossible without breaking invariants.
evidenceClassification.DEFERRED_TO_HOST_RUNTIME: Missing host capability (e.g. live backend API or headless browser runner) is not an architectural failure.

auditPhases: Phase 1: Discovery & Cataloging (file tree, routes, types)
Phase 3: Static Analysis & Schema Integrity (Zod, React Hook Form)
Phase 4: UI/UX Completeness & Accessibility (WCAG 2.2 AA, 44px touch targets, non-color indicators)
Phase 5: Non-Destructive Repair Execution (Zero Feature Eviction)
Phase 6: Verification Gate (Typecheck, Vitest, HTTP 200 Route Verification)
